scope: Bounded Osborn NWI source qualification; native service snapshots in private evidence staging, not statewide package ingestion or parcel screening.
conclusion: The NWI inventory can support qualified discovery of mapped wetland and deepwater features. Source-imagery age, mapping omissions, native geometry holds, and regulatory-boundary differences must accompany downstream use.
verified_source_statements: Four intersecting source-imagery records report IMAGE_YR 1983, IMAGE_DATE 05/83, scale 1:58K, CIR. Comments record NWI Version 2 stream supplementation using NHD 931v220 or 931v210; those strings are not acquisition dates.
USFWS warns that inventory products use a biological definition and cannot establish the presence, absence, or extent of regulated wetlands. On-site conditions can differ from imagery interpretation.
The state download page links Maine GeoPackage and File Geodatabase packages. Neither package is loaded in this bounded service qualification.
State download page labels the current release May 2026. This is not the acquisition date of Osborn source imagery, and package bytes have not been compared with the service.
date_handling: Keep retrieval time, publisher release label, source-image year/month, supplementation lineage and any future field observation date separate. IMAGE_DATE 05/83 has month precision; no invented day or present-day currency.
identity: Wetlands.OBJECTID is a service snapshot identifier. Wetlands.GLOBALID is profiled as a candidate, without assuming persistence across releases or equivalence to state-package IDs.
geometry_policy: Preserve native Esri EPSG:3857 rings. Decode only simple closed rings with unambiguous documented shell/hole roles. Hold failures; do not repair. Project valid decodings into EPSG:26919 for bounded audit calculations. No correction is accepted.
coverage_policy: Availability and source-project coverage do not establish exhaustive mapping. Empty inventory space remains unknown for real or regulated wetlands. Union includes mapped deepwater habitats; it is not a statutory wetland acreage statistic.
regulatory_policy: No automatic crosswalk from Cowardin codes to LUPC P-WL, DEP/NRPA jurisdiction, federal jurisdiction, septic suitability, or buildability. Existing LUPC omitted-protection and legal-currency qualifications remain open.
rights: Exact captured evidence retained privately. This investigation does not establish redistribution rights for every linked dataset, map base, or third-party contribution.
next_action: Resolve TL-F-0027 joined classification conflicts and TL-F-0028 availability geometry; reconcile the Maine package with this bounded service snapshot before wider loading. Preserve May 1983 imagery and NHD lineage, test cross-release identifiers, and retain field delineation/regulatory applicability as separate due-diligence requirements.
classification_policy: Retain eight conflicting joined code definitions as a hold. Exact Wetlands.* attributes and geometry agree across those rows; grouping identical core records is an explicit derived profile, not a source correction.
